title: Fully AI developed multiplayer arena game - Live Round
author: Big-Bag-7504
selftext:
A while back I saw a game posted that was an 8 player pong and I found this inspiring, so I set about creating new variations on the theme. I've made a lot of web games in the past, but I'd never before made a multiplayer one so it was an interesting project.  
Very much not a one-shot prompt, lots of back and forth and a lot of design work, but zero manual intervention in the code, when I saw a mistake I asked AI to figure it out and fix it. The server and client, all entirely AI generated, assets, audio etc, all entirely AI generated and implemented.

Fable took on most of the job, especially the many netcode reviews. I think it's a pretty fun little game and very successful experiment.
